rules.title: Unquoted variable expansion
rules.description: $var unquoted — word splitting and glob expansion corrupt paths with spaces. Use "$var".

rules.title: Missing strict mode
rules.description: Script without set -euo pipefail continues silently after failures and masks unset variables.

rules.title: eval on external input
rules.description: eval with strings containing user or environment input — code injection.

rules.title: Unchecked cd
rules.description: cd without || exit / && — on failure the script operates in the wrong directory (including destructive commands).

rules.title: Predictable temp file
rules.description: Fixed paths in /tmp (e.g. /tmp/$$.tmp) — symlink attacks on shared hosts. Use mktemp.
